label: Greedy heavy-edge matching
subgoals: Visit vertices in the chosen order
Match each unmatched vertex to its unmatched neighbour with the heaviest edge
Leave a vertex single when no unmatched neighbour remains

label: Contracting matched pairs
subgoals: Merge each matched pair into one vertex with summed weight
Merge parallel edges by adding weights
Count n minus the number of pairs for the coarse size

label: Why heavy edges
subgoals: Subtract the matched weight from the total edge weight
Read the remainder as the weight a coarse cut can reach
Rate hypergraph pairs by shared nets weighted by 1/(size - 1)
